annotations.title: utilpeek: upload a file and get a public link that expires within 24 hours

description: utilpeek: Upload a file and get a download link that expires in 24 hours. Returns a public download link to a file you upload, valid for `ttl_hours` (default 24, the most); every call stores a new copy under a new link. Over HTTP the file may also be the raw request body or a multipart `file` part. PDF, Office, ODF, image, audio, CSV, JSON, text and Markdown only, up to 20 MB, detected from the bytes (HTML, SVG, scripts, executables and archives are a 415, not charged). Anyone with the link can download until it expires; Report abuse to support@tanod.dev; links expire within 24 hours. Typically under 1 s. Price: USD 0.005. No free tier. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/upload-file-get-link-for-agents.html

content_base64.description: The file, base64 encoded, up to 20 MB decoded. Allowed: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, ODT, ODS, ODP, PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, TIFF, BMP, MP3, WAV, M4A/MP4 audio, OGG, FLAC, CSV, JSON, TXT, Markdown. HTML, SVG, scripts, executables and archives are refused with 415.
content_base64.title: Content Base64

filename.description: File name with its extension, such as report.pdf. The extension is not trusted: the type is detected from the bytes. It sets the name in the link.
filename.title: Filename

ttl_hours.description: Hours the link stays valid, 1-24 (default 24, the most).
ttl_hours.title: Ttl Hours

name: upload_file_get_link

content_type.description: Detected from the file's bytes, not from the name you sent.

error.description: Only on an error result: an object {code, message}, or the reason string of an x402 PaymentRequired object.

expires_at.description: UTC time the link stops working (within 24 hours).

name.description: The file name in the link.

url.description: Public download link; anyone holding it can read the file until it expires.
